differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned at a low angle, creating a dynamic perspective with visible depth.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned at a high, nearly top-down angle, making the layout look flat.
differences.fix: Lower the camera angle and adjust the focal length to match the perspective of Video A.

differences.a_observable: The white surfaces exhibit a cool, blue color cast.
differences.b_observable: The white surfaces are neutral grey and lack any cool color cast.

differences.a_observable: The shadows beneath the buttons are deep and well-defined, providing high contrast.
differences.b_observable: The shadows are extremely soft and faint, resulting in a flat, low-contrast appearance.
differences.fix: Increase the intensity of the key light and darken the shadows to match Video A.
